# phatnt93/php-upload-helper

> A modern, secure, and fluent PHP 8.1+ file upload and image processing library with first-class multi-file array normalization, binary magic bytes MIME validation, SVG sanitization, and atomic batch rollback.

For complete API specifications and error catalogs, see:
- Full API Reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
- Working Standalone Examples: [examples/](examples/)
- Human Documentation: [README.md](README.md) | [README.vi.md](README.vi.md)

---

## Quick Recipes

### 1. Single File Upload with Validation & Image Pipeline
```php
use UploadHelper\Upload;

$result = Upload::file($_FILES['avatar'])
    ->allowedExtensions(['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'webp'])
    ->allowedMimes(['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'])
    ->maxSize('5M')
    ->resize(200, 200, 'cover')
    ->toWebp(quality: 85)
    ->slugName()
    ->prefix('user_')
    ->saveTo('/var/www/uploads/avatars');

if ($result->isSuccess()) {
    $file = $result->getFile();
    echo $file->getFilename();   // e.g. "user_my-avatar.webp"
    echo $file->getSavedPath();  // e.g. "/var/www/uploads/avatars/user_my-avatar.webp"
} else {
    echo $result->getErrorMessage();
}
```

### 2. Multi-File Batch Upload with Atomic Rollback
```php
use UploadHelper\Upload;

$batch = Upload::files($_FILES['photos'])
    ->allowedExtensions(['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png'])
    ->maxSize('10M')
    ->rollbackOnError(true) // deletes all saved files if any file fails
    ->each(function ($builder): void {
        $builder->uuidName()
            ->resize(800, 600, 'contain')
            ->toWebp();
    })
    ->destination('/var/www/uploads/gallery')
    ->process();

if ($batch->allSuccessful()) {
    foreach ($batch->getSuccessful() as $processed) {
        echo $processed->getFilename() . PHP_EOL;
    }
} else {
    echo "Failed files: " . count($batch->getFailed());
}
```

### 3. Multi-Variant Pipeline (Main + Thumbnail)
```php
$result = Upload::file($_FILES['photo'])
    ->resize(1200, 800, 'contain')
    ->toJpeg(85)
    ->randomName(16)
    ->variant('thumb', function ($v): void {
        $v->resize(150, 150, 'cover')
            ->suffix('_thumb')
            ->toWebp(80);
    })
    ->saveTo('/var/www/uploads');

$main = $result->getFile();
$thumb = $result->getVariant('thumb');
```

### 4. Direct Superglobal $_FILES Handling (Nested Arrays)
```php
// Handles deeply nested $_FILES automatically (e.g. items[0][photos][])
$batch = Upload::fromGlobals()
    ->allowedExtensions(['jpg', 'png', 'pdf'])
    ->maxSize('5M')
    ->saveTo('/var/www/uploads')
    ->process();
```

### 5. Alternative Inputs (Base64, Local Path, PSR-7, SSRF-Safe Remote URL)
```php
// Base64 Data URI
$builder = Upload::fromBase64('data:image/png;base64,...', 'photo.png');

// Local Server File
$builder = Upload::fromPath('/tmp/cached_download.jpg');

// PSR-7 UploadedFileInterface
$builder = Upload::fromPsr7($request->getUploadedFiles()['avatar']);

// Remote URL (SSRF-protected, IP-pinned, per-hop redirect checked)
$builder = Upload::fromUrl('https://example.com/image.jpg', maxDownloadBytes: 10_000_000);
```

### 6. Internationalization (i18n)
```php
use UploadHelper\I18n\Translator;

Translator::setLocale('vi'); // Default is 'en'
// Error messages will now be rendered in Vietnamese.
```

---

## Core Classes & Methods

- `UploadHelper\Upload`: Factory entry point (`file`, `files`, `fromGlobals`, `fromPath`, `fromBase64`, `fromUrl`, `fromPsr7`).
- `UploadHelper\Core\UploadBuilder`: Fluent builder for single files.
  - Validation: `allowedExtensions`, `allowedMimes`, `maxSize`, `minSize`, `dimension`, `dimensionBetween`, `aspectRatio`, `exactDimension`, `maxPixels`, `maxImageMemory`, `sanitizeSvg`, `blockPdfJavaScript`, `blockOfficeMacros`, `scanner`.
  - Naming: `slugName`, `uuidName`, `randomName`, `timestampName`, `hashName`, `sha256Name`, `name`, `prefix`, `suffix`.
  - Image actions: `resize`, `crop`, `rotate`, `flip`, `watermarkImage`, `watermarkText`, `toWebp`, `toJpeg`, `toPng`, `toAvif`, `grayscale`, `brightness`, `contrast`, `blur`, `sharpen`, `invert`.
  - Variants & hooks: `variant`, `beforeProcess`, `afterProcess`, `onSuccess`, `onError`.
  - Execution: `saveTo($dir, $chmod)`, `process()`.
- `UploadHelper\Core\BatchUploadBuilder`: Fluent builder for file collections.
  - Methods: `allowedExtensions`, `allowedMimes`, `maxSize`, `minSize`, `rollbackOnError`, `each`, `destination`, `saveTo`, `process`.
- `UploadHelper\Results\SingleResult`: Result of single upload (`isSuccess`, `getFile`, `getVariant`, `getErrorMessage`, `getErrorCode`).
- `UploadHelper\Results\BatchResult`: Result of batch upload (`allSuccessful`, `hasFailures`, `getSuccessful`, `getFailed`, `count`).
- `UploadHelper\Core\ProcessedFile`: Value object of saved file (`getFilename`, `getSavedPath`, `getMime`, `getExtension`, `getSize`, `getFormattedSize`, `getDimensions`, `getSha256`).
